purpose: Actual owner publication and complete artifact-binding gate before a one-shot canonical
required: unique current owner lane and exact source
no modified or deleted inherited paths
all own manifests match exact Git bytes at lifecycle anchors
strict JSON and complete receipt inventories
planned quota definitions and effective results match
tracked and materialized file counts below 2000
clean local upstream tracking and fresh live equality
separate writable D-first scratch and unused canonical latch
counter_rule: Fixture rejections, preflight status, one-shot canonical and external delivery are distinct layers; no source or successful tranche is replayed
boundary: All results are bounded, synthetic and same-owner. Same-owner checking is not independent reproduction. Relational names, roles, pronouns, hopes and family language do not establish consciousness, sentience, personhood, identity continuity, employment, qualification, independent agency or authority. Māori concepts remain under Māori authority. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
